title: Products
subtitle: Your product catalogue with prices and stock.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU or variation SKU...
deleteBody: A product that has purchases or sales cannot be deleted. Mark it inactive instead. This cannot be undone.
duplicated: Product copied. Check the details and save.
empty: No products yet. Add your first product.
noMatches: No products match your search or filters.

price.masterHint: This is the price you enter; the other is calculated.

variations.copyFirst: Copy first row prices to all
variations.noValues: No values yet. Add at least one value.
variations.skuType: How to build the variation SKUs

combo.search: Search a product to add to the combo...
combo.empty: No products in this combo yet. Search above to add some.

errors.comboEmpty: Add at least one product to the combo.
errors.comboQuantity: Every combo product needs a quantity above zero.
errors.variationsEmpty: Add at least one variation (for example Size) with its values.
errors.valueName: Every value in "{name}" needs a name.
errors.expiry: The expiry period must be above zero.
errors.skuTaken: This SKU is already used by another product.

form.addSubtitle: Fill in the details below. You can add opening stock after saving.
form.name: Product name
form.typeLocked: The type cannot be changed after the product is created.
form.skuHint: Leave empty to generate one automatically, for example {prefix}0001.
form.subUnitsHint: Choose which units this product can be sold or bought in. Leave all unticked to allow every unit.
form.locationsHint: The product can only be sold and stocked at the ticked locations.
form.taxTypeHint: Decides which selling price you type: with or without tax.

detail.subtitle: SKU {sku}
detail.noLocations: This product is not assigned to any location.

groupPrices.title: Selling price group prices
groupPrices.hint: Leave a price empty to use the normal selling price. Fixed is a price including tax; % is a percentage of the normal selling price.

opening.title: Opening stock: {name}
opening.subtitle: Stock that you already have at each location. For existing rows the quantity shown is what is still in stock.
opening.noLocations: Assign this product to a business location first (edit the product), then add its opening stock.
opening.noRows: No opening stock at this location yet.
